justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/visitor/VoidVisitorAdapter.java` and found a very large adapter class: 775 lines with 103 `visit(...)` overrides. The class bundles traversal logic for many separate AST areas in one place (declarations, expressions, statements, types, modules, comments), with no fields or helper decomposition, so it is a single abstraction that could reasonably be split into smaller, more cohesive parts.
